name: Harpy Lieutenants
summary: At the Crossroads, Darsok Swiftdagger sends Horde champions against the Witchwing coven in the northern Barrens. In the Dry Hills, the aim is to kill the flock’s front-line officers and break its chain of command.

sections.title: Targeting the Officers
sections.body: After the first clashes with Witchwing raiders, Darsok Swiftdagger turns the offensive toward the harpies roosting in the Dry Hills. Horde scouts are sent after the Witchwing Slayers who lead the flock. These officers keep the lesser harpies in line and coordinate raids against Horde supply paths. Their deaths are critical to securing the northern approaches of the Barrens.

sections.title: Tokens of Rank
sections.body: Witchwing Slayers lead through strength and dominance, and only the most vicious among them carry ornate rings that mark their authority within the matriarchy. Taking the rings proves the lieutenants are dead, disrupts the roost’s coordination, and sends the coven a clear message: attacks on Horde territory will meet decisive retribution.

sections.title: A Path to the Matriarch
sections.body: Killing the officers throws the lower flock into disarray and serves a broader strategic purpose. Removing the Witchwing roost’s field commanders weakens the perimeter around the heights of the Dry Hills, opening a path toward the inner sanctum of their matriarch, Serena Bloodfeather.

faq.q: Where do I find the harpy lieutenants?
faq.answer: Find the harpy lieutenants in the Dry Hills, a jagged canyon region in the far north of the Barrens, northwest of the Crossroads. Witchwing Slayers patrol the hills.

faq.q: How are these lieutenants identified among the flock?
faq.answer: Witchwing Slayers are the lieutenants of the Witchwing coven. Their distinctive harpy rings mark their authority over lesser scouts and raiders.
Darsok Swiftdagger, an orc scout and coordinator stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens, assigns the contract to protect Horde interests and punish harpy incursions.

faq.q: Why does the Horde want to kill the lieutenants instead of just regular harpies?
faq.answer: The lieutenants direct the lower harpies and organize predatory strikes. Killing them breaks the matriarchy’s leadership and leaves the remaining harpies disorganized and vulnerable.

faq.q: What comes after eliminating the lieutenants?
faq.answer: After the lieutenants are slain, Darsok Swiftdagger directs champions to hunt the flock’s matriarch, Serena Bloodfeather, atop the highest bluffs of the Dry Hills.

faq.q: Why are the Witchwing harpies a threat to the Crossroads?
faq.answer: The Witchwing coven infests the northern passes of the Barrens, preying on travelers, supply caravans, and patrols traveling between the Crossroads, Durotar, and Ashenvale.

angles.text: Securing the northern corridors of the Barrens helps keep communication lines open between Durotar, Mulgore, and the Ashenvale logging camps.
As a rogue, you know the value of striking high-value officers with precision. Darsok Swiftdagger relies on such assassinations instead of costly open warfare.
